dialogue: Pourquoi le téléphone de ton papa est dans le frigo-là ?!
Papa dit chaque fois que tu t'approches, son téléphone chauffe dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The mother, face three-quarters to the camera, holds up the frosty phone and questions the boy. The father stays frozen on his stool. The boy answers proudly, as if he had done a great service, his face clearly visible.
chute: The mother slowly turns her head toward the father, the frosty phone still raised; the father swallows hard. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's terrified face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: PAPA EN CHANGEANT SON MOT DE PASSE :
mecanisme: phrase du papa prise au pied de la lettre : on refroidit le téléphone qui « chauffe »
